title: Source structure name conventions v1
description: Reusable naming tools and named profiles for source structures.

NameConventions.title: Name conventions

ContainerStructureType.title: Container structure type
ContainerStructureType.description: Category of the owning structure for which this naming profile applies.

StructureNaming.title: Structure naming

propertyNames.title: Property Names
propertyNames.description: Structural role supported as a key in the naming rules map.

additionalProperties.title: Additional Properties
additionalProperties.description: Reference to a fragment or composition used to name the selected source role.

StructureNaming.description: Mapping from structural name roles to fragment or composition names.

schema_source_schema_url.title: Schema source schema url
schema_source_schema_url.description: Property in the schema definition that supplies its canonical schema URL; for JSON Schema this is normally $id.

schema_source_schema_identifier.title: Schema source schema identifier
schema_source_schema_identifier.description: Property in the schema definition supplying a stable logical schema identifier independent of the URL. An empty value disables extraction.

schema_source_schema_version.title: Schema source schema version
schema_source_schema_version.description: Property in the schema definition supplying the logical schema version. An empty value disables extraction.

data_source_schema_url.title: Data source schema url
data_source_schema_url.description: Property in an instance document containing the schema URL. An empty value suppresses both writing and automatic reading of this metadata.

data_source_schema_identifier.title: Data source schema identifier
data_source_schema_identifier.description: Property in an instance document containing the logical schema identifier. An empty value suppresses writing and automatic reading. Requires schema_source_schema_identifier.

data_source_schema_version.title: Data source schema version
data_source_schema_version.description: Property in an instance document containing the logical schema version. An empty value suppresses writing and automatic reading. Requires schema_source_schema_version.

additionalProperties.title: Additional Properties
additionalProperties.description: Naming configuration for one category of owning container.

NameConventions.description: Naming rules for supported container structures and their contained source elements.
